_howto: Employee self service (ess_dashboard.html) tours. One page (no sidebar); forms get their own offered tours.
title: Self service tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to your self service
steps.text:
Your hours, leave, claims, payslips and company documents, all in one place, on your phone or computer.

Tap Next to see around. Tap outside or Esc to close.

steps.title: You
steps.text: Your name, number and department.

steps.title: Update my details
steps.text: Your phone numbers, email, emergency contact, address and bank details. Changes to bank details may need proof and approval.

steps.title: Install the app
steps.text: Put self service on your phone's home screen, like an app.

steps.title: Clock in and out
steps.text: If your company allows it, clock in and out here. Your location may be checked.

steps.title: Leave you have
steps.text: Tap to see how much of each kind of leave you have available.

steps.title: Company documents
steps.text: Policies and notices from your company. New ones show a red badge; some need you to read and acknowledge them.

steps.title: Company news
steps.text: Messages and announcements from your company.

steps.title: Your hours
steps.text: Your hours for the period, split into normal time, overtime, Saturday, Sunday and public holidays, then each day below. Use the arrows to go to other periods.

steps.title: Apply for leave
steps.text: Choose the dates and type of leave. It goes to your manager to approve, and you're told when they have.

steps.title: Submit a claim
steps.text: Claim back money you spent for work, with a photo of the receipt.

steps.title: Your requests
steps.text: Requests waiting for approval, and leave coming up. You can cancel a request that hasn't been approved yet.

steps.title: Payslips
steps.text: Your payslips and wage advice slips.

steps.title: My Team
steps.text: For managers: your team's hours and leave, and requests waiting for you.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Tap ? any time for this tour and short guides, such as applying for leave.

steps.title: That's it
steps.text: Each form also has a short tour the first time you open it.

steps.title: Find someone
steps.text: Search your team.

steps.title: Your team
steps.text: Tap a person to see their hours, leave balances and requests. You can also apply for leave or a claim on their behalf.

steps.title: Team Leave
steps.text: Requests waiting for your approval, and who is off when.

steps.title: Team rosters
steps.text: Who works which shift.

steps.title: Waiting for you
steps.text: Requests your team has made. Approve or reject each one; the person is told straight away.

steps.title: Coming up
steps.text: Approved leave in your team.
